title: silene conica subsp. conoidea
intro: Silene conica subsp. conoidea, commonly known as the Horned Catchfly, is a plant species belonging to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of this plant include sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as iridoids and phenolic compounds. Additionally, the plant's bioactive constituents, including glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, may contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
